_comment: Canonical governance wire shapes matching protocol/proto/g8e/common/v1/common.proto. Defines L1Metadata, L2Vote, L2Metadata, L3Proof, L3Metadata, GovernanceMetadata, and GovernanceEnvelope.

l1_metadata._description: L1 Technical Bedrock proof. Serialized from L1Metadata (common.proto).

violations.description: List of L1 doctrine violation strings

l2_vote._description: A single L2 consensus vote from a Tribunal member. Serialized from L2Vote (common.proto).

l2_metadata._description: L2 Consensus proof: a vote set from an enrolled consensus set. Serialized from L2Metadata (common.proto).

consensus_set_id.description: ID of the consensus set that produced this vote set

votes.description: Independent member votes. Each item conforms to the l2_vote shape above.

l3_proof._description: L3 Notary proof (union: WebAuthn or CLI/mTLS). Fields 1-4 are WebAuthn, fields 5-6 are CLI/mTLS. Exactly one proof type should be populated per instance. Serialized from L3Proof (common.proto).

client_data_json.description: WebAuthn: client data JSON from the authenticator assertion

signature.description: WebAuthn: signature over the authenticator assertion

credential_id.description: WebAuthn: credential ID used for the assertion

mtls_cert_fingerprint.description: CLI/mTLS: SHA-256 fingerprint of the CLI certificate

cli_signature.description: CLI/mTLS: Ed25519 signature over transaction_hash using the operator private key

l3_metadata._description: L3 Notary metadata. Serialized from L3Metadata (common.proto).

proof.description: WebAuthn or CLI/mTLS proof. Conforms to the l3_proof shape above.

governance_metadata._description: Unified governance metadata attached to an envelope. Serialized from GovernanceMetadata (common.proto).

l1.description: L1 Technical Bedrock proof. Conforms to the l1_metadata shape above.

l2.description: L2 Consensus proof. Conforms to the l2_metadata shape above.

l3.description: L3 Notary proof. Conforms to the l3_metadata shape above.

governance_envelope._description: Canonical wire format for all g8e mutations. Serialized from GovernanceEnvelope (common.proto). Binds identity, intent, state, and governance proofs into one transaction.

event_type.description: Canonical pub/sub routing key from events.json

intent_data.description: Structured JSON-first view of the intent

target_resource.description: UAP-compatible target resource path or identifier

state_merkle_root.description: Current state Merkle root from the Gateway

governance.description: Governance proofs (L1/L2/L3). Conforms to the governance_metadata shape above.

requestor_user_id.description: Human user who authorized the action (delegator)

acting_app_id.description: App/tool acting on behalf of the user (delegate)
